body.zh-Hant: 坎皮斯特吉生於蒙特維多，出生日期為1859年9月7日。1886年，他加入反抗馬克西莫·桑托斯專制政權的革命運動，由此踏入政壇。他的政治生涯屬於執政的科羅拉多黨，與荷西·巴特列·奧多涅斯關係密切，並且是巴特列所辦報紙《日報》（El Día）的創辦編輯之一。
body.en: Campisteguy was born in Montevideo on 7 September 1859. He entered politics in 1886 by joining the revolutionary movement against the autocratic regime of Máximo Santos. His career within the ruling Colorado Party was closely linked to José Batlle y Ordóñez, and he was one of the founding editors of Batlle's newspaper El Día.

citations.quote: b. 7 September 1859
born in Montevideo

His career within the ruling Colorado Party was closely linked to

of whose newspaper El Día he was one of the founding editors

body.zh-Hant: 1891至1897年間，他兩度擔任眾議員。1897至1898年，他在胡安·林多佛·奎斯塔斯任內出任財政部長，任期涵蓋奎斯塔斯的憲政總統時期，也涵蓋1898年政變之後的獨裁時期。
body.en: He served two terms in the House of Representatives (1891–1897). In 1897–1898 he was minister of finance under Juan Lindolfo Cuestas, both during Cuestas's constitutional presidency and during his autocratic period after the 1898 coup.

citations.quote: After two terms as member of the House of Representatives (1891–1897)
minister of finance (1897–1898) during Juan Lindolfo Cuestas
as well as during his autocratic period following the 1898 coup

body.zh-Hant: 1903至1904年間，他在巴特列政府中擔任政府部長（minister of government），是政府擊敗阿帕里西奧·薩拉維亞所領導的白黨叛亂的籌劃者之一。其後，他於1905至1911年擔任參議員。
body.en: In 1903/1904, as minister of government under Batlle y Ordóñez, he was one of the architects of the government's victory over the Blanco rebellion led by Aparicio Saravia. He was subsequently a senator (1905–1911).

citations.quote: In 1903/1904, as minister of government under Batlle y Ordóñez
one of the architects of the government victory over the Blanco rebellion
led by Aparicio Saravia

heading.zh-Hant: 制憲會議與國家行政委員會
heading.en: Constituent Assembly and National Council of Administration

body.zh-Hant: 1917年，他代表科羅拉多黨里維拉派參加制憲會議，該派反對巴特列引進合議制（colegiado）的計畫。1920至1923年，他再度擔任眾議員；1921至1927年，他是國家行政委員會的成員。
body.en: In 1917 he was a member of the Constituent Assembly for the Colorado Party's Riverista faction, which opposed Batlle's plans to introduce a colegiado system. He was a deputy in 1920–1923 and a member of the National Council of Administration in 1921–1927.

citations.quote: a member of the Constituent Assembly for the Colorado Party's Riverista faction
which opposed Batlle's plans for the introduction of a colegiado system (1917)
a member of the National Council of Administration (1921–1927)

body.zh-Hant: 坎皮斯特吉於1927至1931年擔任烏拉圭總統。任內的重要成就包括1928年設立國營的國家冷凍肉廠（Frigorífico Nacional），以及1929年成立經濟監督委員會（Comité de Vigilancia Económica）。他於1937年去世。
body.en: Campisteguy was president of Uruguay in 1927–1931. Important achievements of his presidency were the creation of the state-owned Frigorífico Nacional (National Meat Packing Plant, 1928) and the Comité de Vigilancia Económica (Committee of Economic Vigilance, 1929). He died in 1937.

people.name: Miguel Abadía Méndez
people.nameZh: 米格爾·阿瓦迪亞·門德斯

body.zh-Hant: 阿瓦迪亞·門德斯於1867年6月5日出生在托利馬省的拉維加德洛斯帕德雷斯（今皮耶德拉斯）。他被送往波哥大受教育，1889年在羅薩里奧學院取得法學博士學位。
body.en: Abadía Méndez was born on 5 June 1867 in La Vega de los Padres (now Piedras), Tolima. He was sent to Bogotá for his education and received his doctorate in law in 1889 from the Colegio del Rosario.

citations.quote: Born in La Vega de los Padres (now Piedras), Tolima
Abadía was sent to Bogotá for his education
received his doctorate in law in 1889 from the Colegio del Rosario

body.zh-Hant: 他成為保守黨理念的宣傳者，擔任過波哥大多家報紙的編輯，也教授歷史與法律。他精力充沛、奉獻且以清廉著稱，因而當選多屆國會議員。他精通憲法，在數個保守黨政權的內閣中任過部長，之後於1926年當選總統。
body.en: He became a publicist for Conservative Party ideals and edited several Bogotá newspapers; he also taught history and law. His energy, dedication and reputation for probity won him election to several congresses. An expert in constitutional law, he served as minister in the cabinets of several Conservative regimes before becoming president in 1926.

citations.quote: He became a publicist for Conservative Party ideals
was editor of several Bogotá newspapers
He also taught history and law.
Abadía's energy, dedication, and deserved reputation for probity
won him election to several congresses
An expert in constitutional law
he served as minister in the cabinets of several Conservative regimes
before becoming president in 1926

heading.zh-Hant: 總統任期與經濟、勞資衝突

body.zh-Hant: 他的總統任期是「保守黨霸權」的最後一段。任內為支應國家基礎建設，又進一步向國外不負責任地舉債。1920年代末的經濟衰退，帶來與石油田（桑坦德）新組織勞工之間日益激烈的衝突，以及1928年11至12月對馬格達萊納香蕉工人罷工的血腥鎮壓。
body.en: His presidency was the last of the "Conservative Hegemony". There was further irresponsible borrowing abroad to support the country's infrastructure. The economic downturn at the end of the 1920s brought increasingly violent confrontations with newly organizing labor in the petroleum fields (Santander) and the bloody repression of the banana workers' strike (Magdalena, November-December 1928).

citations.quote: the last of the "Conservative Hegemony,"
further irresponsible borrowing abroad to support the country's infrastructure
The economic downturn at the end of the 1920s brought increasingly violent
newly organizing labor in the petroleum fields (Santander)
the bloody repression of the banana workers' strike
the banana workers' strike (Magdalena, November-December 1928)

body.zh-Hant: 1929年6月8至9日，波哥大發生民眾與學生示威並有人死亡；他因此被迫撤換戰爭部長等人，保守黨隨之分裂，他的政治生涯結束。他在最後五年罹患嚴重精神疾病，1947年5月15日死於昆迪納馬卡的拉烏尼翁。
body.en: Popular and student demonstrations and deaths in Bogotá on 8–9 June 1929 forced Abadía to fire his war minister and others, the Conservative Party fragmented, and his political life was over. After five years of severe mental illness he died on 15 May 1947 at La Unión, Cundinamarca.

As a result, Abadía was forced to fire his war minister and others
the Conservative Party fragmented
His political life was over.
He died at La Unión, Cundinamarca, after five years of severe mental illness.

heading.en: Second accession and entry into the war

body.zh-Hant: 1940年，米哈伊再度即位。1941年，安東內斯庫領導羅馬尼亞與德國並肩對蘇聯作戰。歷史學者希欽斯指出，國王幾無力改變事態的走向。
body.en: Michael acceded to the throne again in 1940. In 1941 Antonescu led Romania into war against the Soviet Union alongside Germany. The historian Keith Hitchins notes that King Michael had little power to change the course of events.

citations.quote: King Michael found himself on his accession to the throne in 1940
Then, in 1941, Marshal Ion Antonescu
led Romania into war against the Soviet Union alongside Germany
King Michael had little power to change the course of events

body.zh-Hant: 1944年8月，米哈伊一世採取行動，扭轉1940年以來的國家路線，與盟國聯手。希欽斯指出，這一行動使羅馬尼亞回到與西方盟國站在一起的傳統立場。希欽斯並稱他於1947年12月底離開羅馬尼亞。
body.en: In August 1944 King Michael took action to reverse the course initiated in 1940 and joined forces with the Allies. Hitchins notes that this restored Romania's traditional place in Europe as an ally of the West. Hitchins dates his departure from Romania to the end of December 1947.

citations.quote: the actions he took in August 1944 to reverse the course initiated in 1940
together they overthrew the dictatorship and joined forces with the Allies
restoring his country’s traditional place in Europe as an ally of the West
His departure from Romania at the end of December 1947
